_comment: Lists every language and the flat key->text files loaded from data/language/<folder>/. 'files' holds TEXT files only (flat "key": "text"); data files such as events.json, actionphase/decrees.json, achievements.json or config.json are found by the game itself in the language folder and must not be listed. A language falls back to the default language for any text key (and any data file) it does not provide.
